newsitem.title: HONG KONG: DC Finance to sell unit for HK$113.56 mln.
newsitem.headline: DC Finance to sell unit for HK$113.56 mln.

text.p: Mortgage loan financing and property concern DC Finance (Holdings) Ltd said on Tuesday it has agreed to sell its wholly-owned Jalton Profits Ltd to third party Lytton Assets Ltd for a total HK$113.56 million.
Jalton owns 75 percent of Waygain Ltd whose sole asset is a residential property, "Kadoorie Hill Garden", at Kadoorie Hill in Hong Kong's Kowloon district, it said.

The property is being developed into a four-storey residential property comprising 12 residentials units of gross floor area varying between 1,200 square feet to 2,000 square feet and 18 car packing spaces, it said.
DC Finance said the deal would generate a net profit after tax of about HK$43 million for the company.
The company also said it has advanced HK$79.56 million to the buyer to finance the deal.
